title: Programmer Analyst - Android
description: You will lead into the design and development of applications in an agile environment. The success of Mobicule is in your hands as you transform vital business needs into code and drive innovation. You will have access to the new learning, tools and technology, and a limitless career path with the technology leader. Come to Mobicule and create an impact! Knowledge of program architecture Develop, Test and Deploy Code Liaised and Collaborate Database administration Requirements are the core of the programmer analyst’s role. System design and develop software is one of the core skills a programmer analyst is expected to possess. Managing requirements both at the project level and organization level are vital in fulfilling business needs. Formulating program specifications and basic prototypes. Designing high quality database and test efficiency. Requirements analysis Develop procedures and scripts for data migration Knowledge of accessibility and security compliance. Skills & Tools: Excellent debugging skills using command line and Eclipse (crashes and memory leaks). Should be good in using Android Studio, Eclipse/ My Eclipse IDE. Good Knowledge of security concepts and protocols and their usages in mobile application. Good interpersonal skills Strong coding skills, good analytical and problem -solving skills Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications Strong knowledge of Android UI design principles, patterns, and best practices and Should have working knowledge of Constraint Layout Experience with Sqlite/Room and other offline storage mechanism Well versed with code repositories like SVN, Git. Familiarity with RESTful APIs to connect Android applications to back-end services. Requirements Job Responsibility what you will do: Design and build advanced applications for the android platform. Collaborate with cross functional teams to Define, Design, and Ship new features. Should be proficient in working on multi-threaded coding experience along with synchronous and asynchronous code, memory management, and performance tuning and resource optimization. Bug fixing and improving app performance. Unit tests code and delivers high quality work to agreed deadlines. Provide support and Triage during client events which may include out of hours support. Be up-to-date with the latest contemporary android tools, current libraries and best practices Develop engaging apps to help solve problems and meet client expectations. Create documentation to help users understand how to see the program effectively. Why you should join Mobicule? Growing Company: Mobicule is leader in sales force automation via mobile devices. Innovative technologies and aspirants. Move between Roles: We believe that change leads to growth and therefore we allow our employees to shift careers and move to different roles and functions within the organization Get an Exposure: You get to work and deal with our valued customers. Create an Impact: Mobicule gives you the environment to create an impact on the product and transform your ideas into reality. Desired Requirement: Required prior 2years work experience as a in core Java and Android framework Bachelor in Computer Science or equivalent degree. Should have experience in android automation, writing android unit test cases and working with Maven/Ant, GIT.

title: Senior Programmer Analyst
description: Understand use cases and delivery requirements. Design, Develop, review (code/design), unit test, module test, integration test, documentation for SDLC. Maintaining database, enhancing, bug fixing the code. Follow the standard documentation process laid down for the project. Create language codes for programs and review them for errors. Follow the defined SDLC process, understand, and participates in improving the process. Work with cross functional team to achieve project delivery goal. Create a competitive edge in solution by coming out with innovation implementation ideas. Suggest, evaluate, do feasibility study of development and deployment technology. Test the functionality of the program and troubleshoot the issues. Support to cross functional departments for different project/projects module/modules based on priorities to deliver quality software on time. Work on new tasks or multiple tasks depending on business requirements. Ensuring all the work meets or exceeds predefined quality standards through exhaustive testing, peer reviews SQA process standards. Create documentation to help users understand how to see the program effectively. Introducing new ideas, products, features by tracking the latest developments and industry trends. Requirements Good at J2EE,Struts, Spring, JSP, Servlets, Hibernate, Tomcat, J Boss, MySQL, Ant, Maven, CVS, Eclipse Application Servers - JBOSS (Community/Enterprise) and Tomcat. Proven working experience in both Spring Boot and Hibernate Should be good in Linux OS. Should be good in MySQL. Hands-on in DDL, DML, and DCL commands. Amazon AWS glue services knowledge would be an added advantage. Must have knowledge of web-based projects. Good knowledge of device-server integration, JSON and Web Services. Good interpersonal skills. Experience in handling of 5-6 developer team under is must Strong coding skills, good analytical and problem-solving skills. Research on open source frameworks/technologies and integrate them into application. Passionate about creating solutions for customer problems and able to work efficiently with minimal supervision. Holds strong technical proficiency, attention to detail and technological zeal Benefits Why you should join Mobicule? title: Project Manager
description: As a Project Manager, You will be responsible for the providing project planning and management for established initiatives within a company. The success of Mobicule is in your hands as you play vital role in business to ensure projects are completed within established deadline and budget. You will have access to the new learning, tools and technology, and a limitless career path with the technology leader. Resource Management Critical thinking Task Management Project schedule Stakeholder Satisfaction Project Manager role is the lead subject matter expert within company regarding technology concerns. Identifying Technology trends and Project planning which is one of the core skills a Project manager is expected to possess. Managing requirements both at the project level and stakeholder level are vital in fulfilling business needs. Define project scope Keep track of project milestones Create a Timeline of project Track Budget Motivate the team SKILLS: Define project scope Keep track of project milestones Create a Timeline of project Track Budget Motivate the team Define project scope Keep track of project milestones Create a Timeline of project Track Budget Motivate the team Requirements Job Responsibility what you do? Manage projects with top-down oversight throughout entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline. Develop comprehensive project plans that merge customer requirements with company goals and coordinate various managers and technical personnel during all project phases, from initial development through implementation. Hold regular technical team meetings to determine progress and address any questions or challenges regarding projects Monitor project progress continuously and make detailed scheduled reports on measurable items, such as milestones and deliverables. Determine and define clear deliverables, roles and responsibilities for staff members required for specific projects or initiatives. Communicate proactively with all involved personnel to provide encouragement, identify problems, create solutions, and implement efficiency improvements. Analyze economics of project plans and provide actionable feedback relating to cost benefit and return-on-investment standards. Anticipate details of future projects by communicating directly with customers and staying informed of relevant trends and industry news. Why you should join Mobicule? Growing Company: Mobicule is leader in sales force automation via mobile devices. Innovative technologies and aspirants Move between Roles: We believe that change leads to growth and therefore we allow our employees to shift careers and move to different roles and functions within the organization Get an Exposure: You get to work and deal with our valued customers. Create an Impact: Mobicule gives you the environment to create an impact on the product and transform your ideas into reality Desired Requirements: Proven 4-6 years of work experience in IT industry. Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent related experience in a technical field. Deep knowledge in JAVA programming required.
